ddl:
CREATE TABLE Department (
    Department_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Department_Name VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Solid_State_Disk (
    Brand VARCHAR(255),
    Hard_Disk_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Price FLOAT,
    Type VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Customer (
    Contact_Information VARCHAR(255),
    Customer_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Employee (
    Belonging_Department INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Employee_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Telephone VARCHAR(255),
    FOREIGN KEY (Belonging_Department) REFERENCES Department(Department_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Sales_Order (
    Order_Amount FLOAT,
    Order_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Order_Time DATETIME,
    Placing_Customer INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (Placing_Customer) REFERENCES Customer(Customer_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Purchase_Record (
    Purchase_Order_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Purchase_Staff INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Purchase_Time DATETIME,
    Spending_Amount FLOAT,
    FOREIGN KEY (Purchase_Staff) REFERENCES Employee(Employee_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Warehouse (
    Administrator INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Location VARCHAR(255),
    Warehouse_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Warehouse_Name VARCHAR(255),
    FOREIGN KEY (Administrator) REFERENCES Employee(Employee_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Sales_Order_Details (
    Hard_Disk_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Purchase_Quantity INTEGER,
    Sales_Order_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Sales_Order_ID, Hard_Disk_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Hard_Disk_ID) REFERENCES Solid_State_Disk(Hard_Disk_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Sales_Order_ID) REFERENCES Sales_Order(Order_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Purchase_Order_Details (
    Hard_Disk_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Purchase_Order_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Purchase_Quantity INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (Purchase_Order_ID, Hard_Disk_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Hard_Disk_ID) REFERENCES Solid_State_Disk(Hard_Disk_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Purchase_Order_ID) REFERENCES Purchase_Record(Purchase_Order_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Hard_Disk_Storage (
    Hard_Disk_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Reserve INTEGER,
    Warehouse_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (Hard_Disk_ID, Warehouse_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Hard_Disk_ID) REFERENCES Solid_State_Disk(Hard_Disk_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Warehouse_ID) REFERENCES Warehouse(Warehouse_ID)
);
gold_question: The storage management system shall coordinate business processes across departments such as procurement, warehousing, and sales. The procurement department, through procurement personnel, shall be responsible for purchasing solid state drives and storing them in the appropriate warehouse. The warehouse management department shall be responsible for the daily operations of the warehouse, including leasing, managing warehouse personnel, and ensuring the correct storage of solid state drives. The sales department, through sales personnel, shall be responsible for selling solid state drives to customers and arranging shipments. The system shall also store customer information, including name and contact details, to facilitate shipping when sales orders are placed.
